title: Ellevio Stationsentreprenader Q1-2026 — station project
description: One record per station-level project from Ellevio's Q1-2026 station-procurement deck. Covers (a) NordSyd projects (Svenska Kraftnät's transmission-grid reinforcement program in central Sweden), (b) customer-driven projects (driven by specific connection agreements), and (c) supplementary projects (other Ellevio station investments in the same geography). Captures station name, project type, voltage transitions, equipment scope, construction/commission timeline, contract value band, and procurement package grouping.

project_key.description: Stable snake_case ASCII key. Format: ellevio_<program>_<station_normalized>. Examples: ellevio_nordsyd_njutanger, ellevio_supplementary_repbacken, ellevio_customer_tovasen.

project_name.description: Display name. Often equal to station_name; may be an umbrella name when multiple stations are planned together (e.g. 'Östra Hälsingland'). Original Swedish proper nouns preserved.

station_name.description: Primary station name (proper noun, original Swedish spelling preserved).

subproject_grouping.description: Higher-level planning grouping the station belongs to (e.g. 'Östra Hälsingland', 'Laforsen', 'Lindbacka-Karlslund', 'Bollnästriangeln', 'Karlstad benet').

program.description: nordsyd = part of Svenska Kraftnät's NordSyd transmission-grid reinforcement program. customer_driven = driven by a specific customer connection agreement. supplementary = other Ellevio station investment in the same geography but outside NordSyd.

project_type.description: greenfield = entirely new station on a new site. brownfield = reconstruction or expansion of an existing station. ground_work = preparation/site work (typically a precursor procurement). mixed = both ground_work and brownfield/greenfield bundled.

existing_kv.description: Voltage levels at the station before this project.

new_kv.description: Voltage levels at the station after this project completes.

decommissioned_kv.description: Voltage levels being removed by this project.

scope_description.description: Brief English narrative of the station-level work scope.

equipment_scope.description: List of equipment items in scope. Each item is one (equipment_type, voltage_kv, count_range) tuple. The source typically expresses counts as ranges (e.g. '6-8 pcs').

voltage_kv.description: Equipment voltage rating (e.g. 145, 420, 36, 12). Null when not applicable (e.g. transformers crossing voltage levels).

commission_year.description: Year the station enters operation (Gantt 'star' marker).

procurement_start_date.description: Procurement announcement / RFP start date if explicitly stated. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

value_band_msek.description: Contract value band as labeled on the source Gantt: <100 MSEK = under_100; 100-200 MSEK = between_100_and_200; >200 MSEK = over_200; >500 MSEK = over_500.

package_id.description: Procurement package identifier from the Gantt (e.g. '1', '2', '3', '4', or 'separate' for stand-alone procurements).

svenska_kraftnat_dependency.description: True if the project depends on Svenska Kraftnät transmission-grid changes.

customer_agreement.description: Description of any customer connection agreement that drives this project.

related_program.description: Named TSO program this project belongs to (e.g. 'NordSyd').

production_transfer_note.description: Notes on any production-asset transfer (e.g. 'Fortum T3 production transfer to Ellevio').

lifecycle_phase.description: Aligned with sql/draft/007_knowledge_base.sql grid_projects.lifecycle_phase. Mapping from the source's Swedish status labels: 'Utredningsfas' (investigation phase) maps to conceptual. 'Förstudie' (pre-study) and 'Förberedelsefas' (preparation phase) map to permit_pending. 'Nätplaneringsfas (avtal med Svk)' (grid-planning phase, agreement with Svk) maps to permit_pending. 'Projektfas' (project phase) maps to permitted. 'Construction' and 'in_service' apply once the Gantt shows field work started or commissioning passed.

raw_status.description: Original Swedish status label from the source if explicitly stated (e.g. 'Nätplaneringsfas', 'Utredningsfas', 'Behöver inte vara med').

narrative_note.description: Free-text English context that does not fit the structured fields.
